prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a refined GRAPHITE AND RED-CHALK STUDY of one closed vintage book for an adult luxury-retro cultural diary, landscape 3:2. Blank cover and spine, three-quarter overhead view, centred, occupying about 70 percent of the frame. A real artist's tonal sketch: visible graphite grain, broken searching contours, soft dry charcoal shading, a muted brown-burgundy red-chalk cover with incomplete edges that breathe into a nearly white neutral paper ground. The book should have weight, a finely suggested spine and page block, and quiet expressive craftsmanship. This must visibly look drawn by hand in dry media, never photographic or computer-rendered; use fewer observed marks instead of copying every material texture. Mature editorial art direction, intimate and collected rather than illustrative whimsy. No other objects. No writing, book title, letters, numbers, brands, framing border, decorative flourishes, green, olive, yellow, gold, sepia parchment, artificial dirt, children's illustration, cute styling, vector art, smooth glossy gradients or watermark. Keep the object immediately legible when reduced to a mobile thumbnail.
